description.narrative: By 2025, adolescent girls have gained knowledge and skills through education, life skills training, livelihood training, and peer support networks. These assets facilitated a smooth transition to adulthood, enhanced employability, and individual empowerment, and provided increased opportunities to share their voices and influence decisions that affect their lives. title.narrative: Adolescent boys and girls benefited from empowerment interventions to strengthen life skills (self-efficacy, decision making). Through multi-purpose groups, adolescents received information on health, nutrition, sanitation, hygiene, child marriages, gender and child rights and training on peer-to-peer outreach. In addition, adolescent girls, benefitted from providing skills for income and digital skills.;
